theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hinter : ∀ U ∈ P, A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := by
      intro U hU
      by_contra h₂
      have : U ⊆ Aᶜ := by
        intro x hx
        by_contra hx'
        have : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hx', hx⟩
        rw [h₂] at this
        exact this
      have : Aᶜ ∩ U ≠ ∅ := by
        intro h₃
        have : U ⊆ A := by
          intro x hx
          by_contra hx'
          have : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ U := ⟨hx', hx⟩
          rw [h₃] at this
          exact this
        have : U = ∅ := by
          apply Set.eq_empty_of_subset_empty
          intro x hx
          have : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨by tauto, hx⟩
          rw [h₂] at this
          exact this
        rw [this] at hU
        exact Finset.not_mem_empty U hU
      exact h.2 U hU this
    exact hPS ⟨A, h.1, hinter⟩

  have h_not_both : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    have : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by ext x; simp
    have : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc
    contradiction

  classical
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) \ P

  have h₁ : P.card = Q.card := by
    have h₂ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := by
      intro A hA
      simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact h_not_both A hA
    have h₃ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := by
      intro A hA
      simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hA
      cases h_subset_or_compl Aᶜ with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr h =>
        have : Aᶜᶜ = A := by ext; simp
        rw [this] at h
        exact hA.2 h
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    <;> simp_all [Set.compl_compl]

  have h₂ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
      rw [← Finset.card_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ P)]
      simp
    rw [this]
    simp [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]

  have hcard_pos : 0 < Fintype.card S := by
    apply Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr
    exact inferInstance

  have hpow : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by
      have : 1 ≤ Fintype.card S := by omega
      omega
    calc
      2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 ^ 1 := by rfl
      _ = 2 ^ ((Fintype.card S - 1) + 1) := by rw [← pow_add]
      _ = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by rw [this]

  have : 2 * P.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← h₁]
    rw [← two_mul]
    exact h₂

  have : P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) := by
    have : 2 * P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 := by
      rw [hpow]
      exact this
    omega

  exact this
